# Python tools for beast-booter development, installed into .venv by
#   bin/bb-dev setup        (python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-dev.txt)
#
# The installer and bb-dev themselves need only the Python standard library;
# nothing here is shipped on a drive.
#
# Every package (including dependencies) is pinned to one version and to the
# SHA-256 of each of its PyPI files, so `pip install --require-hashes` refuses
# anything else. Versions were at least two weeks old when pinned.
# To update: pick the new versions, take the hashes from
# https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json (digests.sha256 of every file;
# `pip-compile --generate-hashes` produces the same), then check with
#   python3 -m venv /tmp/v && /tmp/v/bin/pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-dev.txt
# Supported: Python 3.10 - 3.14.
#
# pip itself is pinned here too. Hosts without ensurepip (Debian/Ubuntu without
# python3-venv) get it the same way: bb-dev setup creates the venv with
# --without-pip, downloads exactly this pip wheel, checks its SHA-256 below,
# and installs it from the wheel file.

# test runner (installer/tests, devtools/tests, tests/e2e)
